This '''national electoral calendar for 2013''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2013 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

==January==
*11–12 January: [[Elections in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2013 Czech presidential election|President (1st round)]]
*20 January: [[Elections in Austria|Austria]], [[2013 Austrian conscription referendum|Referendum]] 
*22 January: [[Elections in Israel|Israel]], [[2013 Israeli legislative election|Parliament]]
*23 January: [[Elections in Jordan|Jordan]], [[2013 Jordanian parliamentary election|House of Representatives]]
*25–26 January: [[Elections in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2013 Czech presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
*27 January: [[Elections in Bulgaria|Bulgaria]], [[2013 Bulgarian nuclear power referendum|Referendum]]
*28 January: [[Elections in the Bahamas|Bahamas]], [[2013 Bahamian gambling referendum|Referendum]]

==February==
*3 February:
**[[Elections in Cuba|Cuba]], [[2013 Cuban parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Liechtenstein|Liechtenstein]], [[2013 Liechtenstein parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.landtagswahlen.li/resultat/10|title=Results of the 2017 elections|publisher=Information und Kommunikation der Regierung|access-date=14 July 2020}} {{in lang|de}}</ref>
*10 February: [[Elections in Monaco|Monaco]], [[2013 Monegasque parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*17 February: 
**[[Elections in Cyprus|Cyprus]], [[2013 Cypriot presidential election|President (1st round)]]
**[[Elections in Ecuador|Ecuador]], [[2013 Ecuadorian general election|President and Parliament]]
*18 February: [[Elections in Armenia|Armenia]], [[2013 Armenian presidential election|President]]
*19 February: [[Elections in Grenada|Grenada]], [[2013 Grenadian general election|House of Representatives]]
*21 February: [[Elections in Barbados|Barbados]], [[2013 Barbadian general election|House of Assembly]]
*22 February: [[Elections in Djibouti|Djibouti]], [[2013 Djiboutian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*24 February: [[Elections in Cyprus|Cyprus]], [[2013 Cypriot presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
*24–25 February: [[Elections in Italy|Italy]], [[2013 Italian general election|Chamber of Deputies and Senate]]

==March==
*3 March: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2013 Swiss referendums#March referendums|Referendums]]
*4 March: [[Elections in Kenya|Kenya]], [[2013 Kenyan general election#President|President]], [[2013 Kenyan general election#National Assembly|National Assembly]] and [[2013 Kenyan general election#Senate|Senate]]
*5 March: [[Politics of the Federated States of Micronesia|Federated States of Micronesia]], [[2013 Micronesian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*9 March: [[Elections in Malta|Malta]], [[2013 Maltese general election|Parliament]]
*10–11 March: ''[[Politics of the Falkland Islands|Falkland Islands]], [[2013 Falkland Islands sovereignty referendum|Referendum]]''
*12 March: ''[[Elections in Greenland|Greenland]], [[2013 Greenlandic parliamentary election|Legislature]]''
*13 March: ''[[Norfolk Island Legislative Assembly|Norfolk Island]], [[2013 Norfolk Island election|Legislature]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.election.gov.nf/|title=Election – 2013|publisher=Norfolk Island Government|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131109143501/http://www.election.gov.nf/|access-date=17 July 2020|archive-date=9 November 2013}}</ref>
*16 March: [[Elections in Zimbabwe|Zimbabwe]], [[2013 Zimbabwean constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]

==April==
*7 April: [[Elections in Montenegro|Montenegro]], [[2013 Montenegrin presidential election|President]]
*14 April: [[Elections in Venezuela|Venezuela]], [[2013 Venezuelan presidential election|President]]
*21 April: 
**''[[Elections in French Polynesia|French Polynesia]], [[2013 French Polynesian legislative election|Legislature (1st round)]]''
**[[Elections in Paraguay|Paraguay]], [[2013 Paraguayan general election|President, Chamber of Deputies and Senate]]
*23 April: [[Elections in Bhutan|Bhutan]], [[2013 Bhutanese National Council election|National Council]]
*24 April: ''[[Elections in Jersey|Jersey]], [[2013 Jersey electoral reform referendum|Referendum]]''
*27 April: [[Elections in Iceland|Iceland]], [[2013 Icelandic parliamentary election|Parliament]]

==May==
*5 May: 
**''[[Elections in French Polynesia|French Polynesia]], [[2013 French Polynesian legislative election|Legislature (2nd round)]]''
**[[Elections in Malaysia|Malaysia]], [[2013 Malaysian general election|House of Representatives]]
*11 May: [[Elections in Pakistan|Pakistan]], [[2013 Pakistani general election|National Assembly]]
*12 May: [[Elections in Bulgaria|Bulgaria]], [[2013 Bulgarian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*13 May: [[Elections in the Philippines|Philippines]], [[2013 Philippine House of Representatives elections|House of Representatives]] and [[2013 Philippine Senate election|Senate]]
*22 May: ''[[Elections in the Cayman Islands|Cayman Islands]], [[2013 Caymanian general election|Legislature]]''
*26 May: [[Elections in Equatorial Guinea|Equatorial Guinea]], [[2013 Equatorial Guinean legislative election|Chamber of Deputies and Senate]]
*31 May: [[Elections in Bhutan|Bhutan]], [[2013 Bhutanese National Assembly election|National Assembly (1st round)]]

==June==
*8 June: [[Elections in Nauru|Nauru]], [[2013 Nauruan parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*9 June: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2013 Swiss referendums#June referendums|Referendums]]
*14 June: [[Elections in Iran|Iran]], [[2013 Iranian presidential election|President]]
*23 June: [[Elections in Albania|Albania]], [[2013 Albanian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*26 June: [[Elections in Mongolia|Mongolia]], [[2013 Mongolian presidential election|President]]

==July==
*13 July: [[Elections in Bhutan|Bhutan]], [[2013 Bhutanese National Assembly election|National Assembly (2nd round)]]
*21 July: [[Elections in Japan|Japan]], [[2013 Japanese House of Councillors election|House of Councillors]]
*25 July: [[Elections in Togo|Togo]], [[2013 Togolese parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*27 July: [[Elections in Kuwait|Kuwait]], [[2013 Kuwaiti general election|Parliament]]
*28 July: 
**[[Elections in Cambodia|Cambodia]], [[2013 Cambodian general election|National Assembly]]
**[[Elections in Mali|Mali]], [[2013 Malian presidential election|President (1st round)]]
**''[[Elections in Northern Cyprus|Northern Cyprus]], [[2013 Northern Cyprus parliamentary election|Parliament]]''
*31 July: [[Elections in Zimbabwe|Zimbabwe]], [[2013 Zimbabwean general election|President, National Assembly and Senate]]<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-23188772|title=Zimbabwe court rejects Mugabe, Tsvangirai bid to delay poll|date=4 July 2013|work=[[BBC News]]|access-date=21 July 2013}}</ref>

==August==
*11 August: [[Elections in Mali|Mali]], [[2013 Malian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]

==September==
*7 September: 
**[[Elections in Australia|Australia]], [[2013 Australian federal election|House of Representatives and Senate]]
**[[Elections in the Maldives|Maldives]], [[2013 Maldivian presidential election|<s>President (1st round)</s>]] (election nullified)
*8–9 September: [[Elections in Norway|Norway]], [[2013 Norwegian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*15 September: ''[[Elections in Macau|Macau]], [[2013 Macanese legislative election|Legislature]]''
*16–18 September: [[Elections in Rwanda|Rwanda]], [[2013 Rwandan parliamentary election|Chamber of Deputies]]
*20 September: [[Elections in Eswatini|Swaziland]], [[2013 Swazi general election|House of Assembly]]
*22 September: 
**[[Elections in Germany|Germany]], [[2013 German federal election|Bundestag]]
**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2013 Swiss referendums#September referendums|Referendums]]
*27 September: ''[[Elections in Aruba|Aruba]], [[2013 Aruban general election|Legislature]]''
*28 September: [[Elections in Guinea|Guinea]], [[2013 Guinean legislative election|Parliament]]
*29 September: [[Elections in Austria|Austria]], [[2013 Austrian legislative election|National Council]]
*30 September: [[Elections in Cameroon|Cameroon]], [[2013 Cameroonian parliamentary election|National Assembly]]

==October==
*4 October:  [[Elections in the Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], [[2013 Irish constitutional referendums|Constitutional Referendums]]
*9 October: [[Elections in Azerbaijan|Azerbaijan]], [[2013 Azerbaijani presidential election|President]]
*20 October: 
**[[Elections in Luxembourg|Luxembourg]], [[2013 Luxembourgian general election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in San Marino|San Marino]], [[2013 Sammarinese referendum|Referendums]]
*25 October: [[Elections in Madagascar|Madagascar]], [[2013 Malagasy general election|President (1st round)]]
*25–26 October: [[Elections in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2013 Czech legislative election|Chamber of Deputies]]
*27 October: 
**[[Elections in Argentina|Argentina]], [[2013 Argentine legislative election|Chamber of Deputies and Senate]]
**[[Elections in Georgia (country)|Georgia]], [[2013 Georgian presidential election|President]]

==November==
*6 November: [[Elections in Tajikistan|Tajikistan]], [[2013 Tajikistani presidential election|President]]
*7 November: ''[[Elections in the Falkland Islands|Falkland Islands]], [[2013 Falkland Islands general election|Legislature]]''<ref name="mercopress">{{cite news |title=Falklands' next general election announced for 7 November |url=http://en.mercopress.com/2013/07/29/falklands-next-general-election-announced-for-7-november |newspaper=MercoPress |date=29 July 2013 |access-date=29 July 2013}}</ref>
*9 November: [[Elections in the Maldives|Maldives]], [[2013 Maldivian presidential election|President (1st round revote)]]<ref name="BBC-Maldives">{{cite news|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-24887515|title=Maldives election: Supreme Court delays run-off vote|date=9 November 2013|work=[[BBC News]]|access-date=9 November 2013}}</ref>
*12 November: ''[[Politics of the Pitcairn Islands|Pitcairn Islands]], [[2013 Pitcairnese general election|Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Legislature]]''
*16 November: [[Elections in the Maldives|Maldives]], [[2013 Maldivian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref name="BBC-Maldives"/>
*17 November: [[Elections in Chile|Chile]], [[2013 Chilean general election#President|President (1st round)]], [[2013 Chilean general election#Chamber of Deputies|Chamber of Deputies]] and [[2013 Chilean general election#Senate|Senate]]
*19 November: [[Elections in Nepal|Nepal]], [[2013 Nepalese Constituent Assembly election|Constituent Assembly]]
*23 November: [[Elections in Mauritania|Mauritania]], [[2013 Mauritanian parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]
*24 November: 
**[[Elections in Honduras|Honduras]], [[2013 Honduran general election|President and Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Mali|Mali]], [[2013 Malian parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]
**[[List of Swiss federal referendums|Switzerland]], [[2013 Swiss referendums#November referendums|Referendums]]

==December==
*1 December: [[Elections in Croatia|Croatia]], [[2013 Croatian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]
*13 December: [[Elections in New Zealand|New Zealand]], [[2013 New Zealand asset sales referendum|Referendum]]
*15 December: 
**[[Elections in Chile|Chile]], [[2013 Chilean presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Mali|Mali]], [[2013 Malian parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Turkmenistan|Turkmenistan]], [[2013 Turkmenistani parliamentary election|Assembly]]
*20 December: [[Elections in Madagascar|Madagascar]], [[2013 Malagasy general election|President (2nd round) and National Assembly]]
*21 December: [[Elections in Mauritania|Mauritania]], [[2013 Mauritanian parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]

==Indirect elections==
The following [[indirect election]]s of [[head of state|heads of state]] and the [[upper house]]s of bicameral legislatures took place through votes in elected [[lower house]]s, [[Unicameralism|unicameral legislatures]], or [[electoral college]]s: 
*15 February: [[Elections in Trinidad and Tobago|Trinidad and Tobago]], [[2013 Trinidad and Tobago presidential election|President]]
*24 February: [[Elections in Cuba|Cuba]], [[2013 Cuban executive elections|President and Council of State]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.juventudrebelde.cu/cuba/2013-02-24/diputados-cubanos-ratifican-a-raul-como-presidente-del-consejo-de-estado|title=Cuban deputies ratify Raúl as president of the Council of State|work=[[Juventud Rebelde]]|language=es|date=24 February 2013|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*12–13 March: [[Politics of Vatican City|Vatican City]], [[2013 conclave|Pope]]
*18 March: ''[[Elections in the Isle of Man|Isle of Man]], [[2013 Manx Legislative Council election|Legislative Council]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-isle-of-man-21802574|title=Four elected on to Isle of Man Legislative Council|work=[[BBC News]]|date=18 March 2013|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*28 March, 24 April, 24 May and 19 June: [[Elections in Austria|Austria]], [[2013 Austrian Federal Council elections|Federal Council]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ktn.gv.at/Politik/Landtag/Stenographische-Protokolle|title=Stenographic records, 31st legislative period 2013 - 2018: 1st LTG meeting on March 28, 2013|publisher=Office of the Carinthian Provincial Government|language=de|access-date=27 December 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ots.at/presseaussendung/OTS_20130424_OTS0241/konstituierende-sitzung-des-noe-landtages|title=Constituent meeting of the Lower Austrian Parliament|website=APA-OTS|language=de|date=24 April 2013|access-date=27 December 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tirol.gv.at/fileadmin/landtag/downloads/2013/Homepage/2013_Tiroler_Landtag_NEU.pdf|title=Der Tiroler Landtag stellt sich vor|publisher=Office of the Tyrolean Provincial Government|language=de|pages=16–17|access-date=27 December 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ots.at/presseaussendung/OTS_20130619_OTS0137/landtag-waehlte-regierung-mit-wilfried-haslauer-als-landeshauptmann|title=Landtag elected government with Wilfried Haslauer as governor|website=APA-OTS|language=de|date=19 June 2013|access-date=27 December 2020}}</ref>
*1 April: [[Elections in San Marino|San Marino]], [[Captains Regent]]
*14 April: [[Elections in Cameroon|Cameroon]], {{ill|2013 Cameroonian senatorial election|lt=Senate|fr|Élections sénatoriales camerounaises de 2013}}<ref>{{cite web|url=http://digest.electionguide.org/2013/04/02/focus-on-cameroon’s-first-senate-race/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130426055843/http://digest.electionguide.org/2013/04/02/focus-on-cameroon%E2%80%99s-first-senate-race/|title=Focus On: Cameroon's First Senate Race|publisher=[[International Foundation for Electoral Systems]]|date=2 April 2013|archive-date=26 April 2013|access-date=21 December 2020}}</ref>
*18–20 April: [[Elections in Italy|Italy]], [[2013 Italian presidential election|President]]
*22 April: [[Elections in Bangladesh|Bangladesh]], [[2013 Bangladeshi presidential election|President]]
*30 May and 27 June: [[Elections in India|India]], [[2013 Rajya Sabha elections|Council of States]]
*11 June: [[Elections in Nauru|Nauru]], [[2013 Nauruan presidential election|President]]
*30 July: [[Elections in Pakistan|Pakistan]], [[2013 Pakistani presidential election|President]]
*30 September: [[Elections in Dominica|Dominica]], [[2013 Dominican presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://dominicanewsonline.com/news/homepage/news/politics/breaking-news-charles-savarin-officially-elected-president/|title=Charles Savarin officially elected as president|work=Dominica News Online|date=30 September 2013|access-date=21 December 2020}}</ref>
*1 October: [[Elections in San Marino|San Marino]], [[Captains Regent]]
*7 October: [[Elections in Ethiopia|Ethiopia]], [[2013 Ethiopian presidential election|President]]
